# Summary

Python engine providing schema generation, validation, and backend functionality.

# Docs

## Files

- `main.py` - Main engine module with Kit parsing, validation, transformation, dev-mode startup flag, and stdio MCP startup flag
- `engine.test.py` - Unit tests for engine functionality
- `generate-schemas.ts` - Generates GraphQL, JSON, and SQL schemas from TypeScript definitions
- `sqliteschema.ts` - SQLite schema generation utilities

# 💯Requirements

## Engine

Engine startup MUST support a dev/debug mode flag that waits for debugger attachment before runtime begins.

Engine startup MUST support a pure stdio MCP server mode.

import importlib.util
import pathlib
import sys

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent

# Load compose/py/main.py as 'main' (the compose core library)
_compose_py_path = str(root / "compose" / "py" / "main.py")
_compose_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", _compose_py_path)
_compose_mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_compose_spec)
sys.modules["main"] = _compose_mod
_compose_spec.loader.exec_module(_compose_mod)

compose = _compose_mod  # noqa: F841
compose.__path__ = [str(root / "compose")]

# Load compose/engine/main.py as 'engine'
_engine_path = str(root / "compose" / "engine" / "main.py")
_engine_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("engine", _engine_path)
engine = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_engine_spec)  # noqa: F841
sys.modules["engine"] = engine
_engine_spec.loader.exec_module(engine)

name = "compose-engine"
version = "4.4.0"
description = "⚙️️️Shared fat client for all desktop apps in compose 🏘️"
authors = [{ name = "Ueli Saluz", email = "ueli@semio-tech.com" }]
requires-python = ">=3.14"
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
maintainers = [{ name = "Ueli Saluz", email = "ueli@semio-tech.com" }]
dependencies = [
    "compose",
    "fastapi[standard]>=0.115.12",
    "graphene>=3.4.3",
    "graphene-pydantic>=0.6.1",
    "graphene-sqlalchemy>=3.0.0rc2",
    "jinja2>=3.1.6",
    "lark>=1.2.2",
    "loguru>=0.7.3",
    "networkx>=3.5",
    "numpy>=2.2.6",
    "openai>=1.83.0",
    "pint>=0.24.4",
    "pydantic>=2.11.5",
    "pyside6>=6.9.1",
    "python-dotenv>=1.1.0",
    "pytransform3d>=3.14.1",
    "requests>=2.32.3",
    "sqlalchemy>=2.0.41",
    "sqlmodel>=0.0.24",
    "starlette>=0.46.2",
    "starlette-graphene3>=0.6.0",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.34.3",
    "mcp[cli]>=1.25.0",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/usalu/semio"
Repository = "https://github.com/usalu/semio"

[project.scripts]
run = "main:run"
dev = "main:dev"

[dependency-groups]
test = ["pytest>=8.4.0,<10", "deepdiff>=8.5.0,<9", "pytest-cov>=6.1.1,<8"]
dev = []
build = ["pyinstaller>=6.13.0,<7"]

[tool.uv]
default-groups = ["test", "dev", "build"]

[tool.uv.sources]
compose = { workspace = true }

[tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist]
include = ["main.py"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
include = ["main.py"]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_also = [
    "def __repr__",
    "def __str__",
    "def client__str__",
    "def list_client__str__",

    "raise AssertionError",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "raise InvalidDatabase",
    "raise InvalidBackend",

    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "def main():",
    "if app.debug:",

    "@(abc\\.)?abstractmethod",
]

ignore_errors = true

[tool.tox]
legacy_tox_ini = """
    [tox]
    isolated_build = true

    [testenv]
    skip_install = true
    allowlist_externals = uv
    commands_pre = uv sync
    commands = uv run pytest
"""

[tool.pylint.'MESSAGES CONTROL']
extension-pkg-whitelist = "pydantic"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 250

[tool.pyright]
disable = ["reportMissingImports"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py", "*.test.py"]
testpaths = ["."]
addopts = "--import-mode=importlib"

Here is what was wrong and what we did.

## Cause

A **repo-wide comment stripper** did more than remove comments:

1. **`compose/engine/main.py`** — In commit `c522b2737`, huge chunks of real code were removed (hundreds of lines), leaving invalid fragments (`try:` with no call, half a `json.dump(...)`, etc.).
2. **`compose/py/main.py`** — In commit `80bfd6772`, **`#` was stripped from section markers** so lines like `# [👤compose…](repo://…)` became bare `[👤compose…]`, which Python treats as invalid syntax.
3. **`coda/engine/coda.py`** — Same kind of damage as (2).

So the engine failed because **`compose/py/main.py` could not import**, and **`compose/engine/main.py` did not parse**.

## Fix

Content was **restored from git history** (read-only `git show`, no checkout):

| File | Restored from |
|------|----------------|
| `compose/engine/main.py` | `80bfd6772` (last good before the big deletion in `c522b2737`) |
| `compose/py/main.py` | `41b248ef4` (before the `#`-strip bug in `80bfd6772`) |
| `coda/engine/coda.py` | `41b248ef4` (same) |

## Checks

- `python3 -m py_compile` on those three files — OK  
- `python3 -c "import compose.engine.main"` with `PYTHONPATH` set — OK  
- `pytest compose/engine/engine.test.py` — **174 passed**

Ticket **Restore Engine After Comment Stripping** (`26/04/04/RESTORE-ENGINE-AFTER-COMMENT-STRIPPING`) is opened and closed; notes are in `.repo/🎫/26/04/04/RESTORE-ENGINE-AFTER-COMMENT-STRIPPING/restore-notes.md`.

**Going forward:** do not use a naive “remove all `#` comments” pass on this codebase — **region/section markers and repo links must stay commented**, or use an AST-based tool that only drops real comment tokens.
